newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor recovers after poor overseas trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor recovers after poor overseas trade.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices recovered on Monday to 1,176/1,177 rupees per quintal on limited new crop arrivals after falling on sluggish overseas to 1,170 rupees in early trade, dealers said.
"Reports of lower arrivals at producing centres ahead of the Hindu kite festival triggered renewed bull buying," one dealer said. The festival, a religious occasion, is on January 14.
Traders expect arrivals to pick up after this.
Groundnut oil was unchanged at 352/353 rupees per 10 kg on lower arrivals of 60/70 tonnes.
Rajkot spot oil was steady at 5,200/525 rupees per 15 kg.
